sloka: तेनोरसि निबद्धेन हारेण महता कपिः ।रराज हेमशैलेन्द्रश्चन्द्रेणाक्रान्तमस्तकः ।। ७.४०.२४ ॥
transliteration: tenorasi nibaddhena hāreṇa mahatā kapiḥ ।rarāja hemaśailendraścandreṇākrāntamastakaḥ ।। 7.40.24 ॥

translations.english: With that great necklace fastened on his chest, Hanuman shone like a magnificent golden mountain whose peak is adorned by the moon.
